name: What are my rights during a federal criminal investigation?

mainEntity.name: What are my rights during a federal criminal investigation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a federal investigation, you have the right to remain silent, the right to counsel, and the right to avoid self-incrimination. Consult an attorney before answering any questions or consenting to searches.heathhydelawyer​
